Among the 68 artworks being donated to Williams are pieces by such contemporary artists as Tracy Emin, Anna Gaskell, Adrian Piper, Allan Ruppersberg, Kathleen Schimert, Nayland Blake and Christopher Woo, many of them newcomers to the museum’s collection. They span the early 1990s to mid-2000s.

All of the pieces being donated comes from Norton’s personal collection. Best known for his anti-virus software, he made his first, flush round of art donations in 2000, when he gave more than 1,000 pieces to 32 institutions.
